title: IAMMAI Accession Candidate Declaration
description: First intake declaration schema for one bounded accession candidate slice. This schema is slice-first, provenance-oriented, strict about source/export/case/scope distinction, and limited to candidacy review rather than proof, admission, vesselhood, standing, or closure.

external_system_name.description: Name of the outside system from which the candidate slice is being declared.

candidate_slice_name.description: Human-readable name for the one bounded candidate slice being submitted for first candidacy review.

candidate_slice_id.description: Bounded identifier for the candidate slice declaration.

slice_type.description: Typed label for the candidate slice being declared.

included_scope.description: Explicit bounded scope that is inside the candidate slice declaration.

excluded_scope.description: Explicit bounded scope that is outside the candidate slice and must not be silently smuggled in by adjacency.

source_object_paths.description: Paths naming the source-side objects from which the candidate slice is exported or derived.

export_slice_paths.description: Paths naming the concrete exported slice surfaces being handed in for first candidacy review.

clean_case_paths.description: Paths naming bounded clean cases that show the candidate slice in an intended or legible state.

blocked_case_paths.description: Paths naming bounded blocked cases that show where the candidate slice fails, stops, or remains non-ready.

source_description.description: Bounded description of what counts as source for the candidate slice.

export_description.description: Bounded description of what counts as the exported or handed-in slice under review.

display_only_description.description: Bounded description of what is display-only or non-source presentation so source/export/display distinction remains explicit.

proof_question.description: One bounded proof-question seed for later candidacy review of this single declared slice.
